verdict.rationale: The CLI installs one canonical skill folder into 77+ different agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and others) via symlinks, and `skills init` scaffolds a SKILL.md. The agentskills.io spec defines that same SKILL.md format (YAML frontmatter plus Markdown, optional fields like `license`) and promises build-once reuse across compatible agents. A community member also praised the agent-agnostic approach. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that skills.sh/the CLI conforms to the Agent Skills specification, evidence that the CLI validates skills against the spec (only the separate `skills-ref validate` tool is shown), and hands-on confirmation that one folder works unchanged in a non-Vercel tool.
